metas.name: 2026 · Godzilla Minus Zero
metas.description: Direct continuation of Takashi Yamazaki's Godzilla Minus One.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
metas.description: Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily cancelled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 2026 · Motor City
metas.description: In 1970s Detroit, John Miller falls for a local gangster's girl. In retaliation, the gangster enacts a frame job to send the innocent man to prison. Life ruined, Miller plots a revenge campaign against the man who took his girl away.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2026 · PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
metas.description: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1979 · Christ Stopped at Eboli
metas.description: A doctor in Fascist Italy is exiled to a remote village for his political views.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2008 · Jalsa
metas.description: Sanjay, a young man, joins an extremist group after having had a troublesome childhood. A policeman decides to guide him towards a far better path and in doing so, his daughter falls crazy with Sanjay.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2002 · Manmadhudu
metas.description: Abhiram, a misogynist, works as a manager in his own advertising agency. When his uncle, the chairman, appoints Harika as an assistant manager, he mistreats her, but his hatred soon turns into love.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · Tu Hai Meri Kiran
metas.description: What starts as a real connection for her turns into his all-consuming obsession. As love darkens, the boundary between devotion and danger fades.

metas.name: 2026 · Wild Horse Nine
metas.description: CIA agents Chris and Lee face a trust-testing mission from Santiago to Easter Island during 1973 in Chile.

metas.name: 2026 · Apocalypse Z: New World
metas.description: A supply mission to virus-ravaged Spain turns complex when Roberto, from the safe Canary Islands, joins with secret intentions. The team confronts infected masses and trust issues while weighing survival against humanity.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2021 · JFK Revisited: Through the Looking Glass
metas.description: Declassified files related to President Kennedy's assassination in a far larger context, aiming to shine more light on what really happened in 1963.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · Drones
metas.description: A sleepwalking student, a mysterious miniature artist, an ancient witch, a doll house of trapped souls, and a cop cursed by love collide in a surreal world.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2022 · After Yang
metas.description: In a near future, a family reckons with questions of love, connection, and loss after their A.I. helper unexpectedly breaks down.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2026 · Klara and the Sun
metas.description: When Klara, an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home, meets Josie, each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother and they've suffered great loss, but Klara's innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie's complicated world.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2014 · The Battered Bastards of Baseball
metas.description: The Battered Bastards of Baseball is one of baseball's last great, unheralded true stories. In 1973, Hollywood veteran Bing Russell (best known for playing Deputy Clem on "Bonanza") created the only independent baseball team in America at the time, the legendary Portland Mavericks. Bing operated without a Major League affiliation while playing in a city that was considered a wasteland for professional baseball. Tryouts for the Mavericks, which were open to the public, were filled with hopefuls who arrived in droves from every state in America, many of whom had been rejected by organized baseball. Skeptics agreed it would never work. But Bing's Mavericks generated unprecedented success: they shattered attendance records, signed Kurt Russell - Bing's son - as a player and team Vice President, produced the most successful batboy in baseball (filmmaker Todd Field), re-launched the controversial career of Jim Bouton, hired the first female general manager in Baseball, and inspired one of America's beloved bubblegums - Big League Chew. The Battered Bastards of Baseball is as much about the independent spirit as it is about baseball. The Mavericks' in your face attitude was contagious to fans, and during their short reign, they - and Bing Russell - basically held up their middle finger to the sports establishment and said we're playing this game on our terms, not yours. They were the real life Bad News Bears.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · The Last First: Winter K2
metas.description: K2's first winter ascent claimed 5 lives, revealing modern alpinism's struggles with commercialization, social media impact, and conflicts between marginalized climbers and traditional elites.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2012 · Thattathin Marayathu
metas.description: The struggles faced when a Hindu man falls in love with a Muslim woman and the disapproval of her family.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 1998 · A Perfect Murder
metas.description: Wealthy Wall Street speculator Steven Taylor finds that his wife Emily Bradford has a lover, struggling artist David Shaw. Steven investigates Shaw and manipulates him into murdering Emily. It seems like a perfect crime.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1971 · The Devils
metas.description: In 17th-century France, Father Urbain Grandier's protection of the city of Loudun from the corrupt Cardinal Richelieu is undermined by a sexually repressed nun's accusation of witchcraft.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2025 · Dead of Winter
metas.description: A woman, travelling alone through snowbound northern Minnesota, interrupts the kidnapping of a teenage girl. Hours from the nearest town and with no phone service, she realizes that she is the young girl's only hope.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · Eesha
metas.description: Four friends set out to challenge blind beliefs, only to be drawn into a mysterious spiritual encounter that changes their lives forever.

metas.name: ★ 5.4 · 2026 · The Dark Heaven
metas.description: In the Hill Village of Mekkarai, Where It is Customary for Men to Die Every Seven Years During the Month of June, a Newly Appointed Police Inspector Arrives to Investigate a Series of Mysterious Murders. As He Digs Deeper Into the Village's Dark Secrets and Long-standing Beliefs, He Finds Himself Trapped in a Web of Crime, Fear, and Hidden Truths.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2026 · Chiram
metas.description: Seetha, a young Malayali research student who travels to Visva-Bharati University in Kolkata to study traditional Baul music and culture.

metas.name: 2026 · Ali G: Who Iz I?
metas.description: Hip-hop journalist Ali G returns after 20 years to make a documentary with real people. Cameras follow him for over a year as he takes classes, walks the streets, and appears on shows, often with his pregnant girlfriend.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2026 · The Death of Robin Hood
metas.description: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.
